unit.why: The division holds two short anecdotes inside a homiletic frame: Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev talking about worldly matters while wearing tallit and tefillin, and a visitor who copied R. Nahman's coffee-drinking in tallit and tefillin. Both are used to warn against imitating a tzaddik's acts.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with footnotes (catchword stub and a halakhic note on blessing over tallit/tefillin bought from gentiles or thieves) that belong to the paratext apparatus

stories.start_quote: כמו ששמעתי מכבוד קדושת אאמו״ר המגיד
stories.end_quote: כל הדבורים מפשוטי העם אל השורש העליון
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Kozienice told that R. Levi Yitzhak of Berdichev, wearing tallit and tefillin, would chat with everyone about worldly affairs while staying in devekut and raising their words to their source. The author warns that ordinary people must not imitate this.

tags.why: the anecdote turns on his conduct while wearing tefillin

quotes: ולא היה מפסיק מדביקותו ית׳ אף רגע
tags.why: his unbroken cleaving to God during worldly talk

quotes: והי׳ עושה כל מעשיו בהתקשרות הבורא ב״ה
tags.why: depicted as being in constant communion

quotes: המגיד הק' מקאזניץ שסיפר לי מהה״ק
tags.why: framed as a tale told by a named tsaddik
the anecdote is wrapped in a homiletic and cautionary frame

quotes: להעלות כל הדבורים מפשוטי העם אל השורש העליון
tags.why: the tsaddik's special power to elevate others' speech

quotes: ובוודאי שלא כל הרוצה ליטול את השם
tags.why: a warning not to imitate the tsaddik

missing_concepts: elevating mundane speech to its higher root
danger of imitating a tsaddik's unusual conduct

stories.start_quote: שבא אחד אל הרב המפורסם מוהר"ן
stories.end_quote: ונסע לביתו והתחיל לנהוג ג״כ כך
stories.summary_en: A man visiting R. Nahman (as cited in Degel Mahaneh Ephraim) saw him drinking coffee in tallit and tefillin and adopted the practice at home. The homily explains that the tsaddik was then in a state of katnut and must not be imitated.

tags.why: the copied act is drinking coffee while in tefillin

quotes: שבא א׳ אצל הצדיק כדי ללמוד ממעשיו
tags.why: a visitor comes to the tsaddik to learn from his deeds
the anecdote illustrates an exegesis of a Numbers verse

quotes: ולא יבואו לראות כבלע את הקדש ומתו
tags.why: the frame is a verse interpreted as a tsaddik's teaching

quotes: כ״א שיראה זמן הגדלות ויקבל ממנו
tags.why: teaches when and how to receive from a tsaddik
a follower wrongly learns from the master
